cd /workspace/project && python3 -c "
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')
# Check server/dist structure
print('=== Server Dist Structure ===')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('ls -la /root/opt/areloria/server/dist/modules/ 2>/dev/null | head -20')
# Check the package.json for build scripts
print('\\n=== Package.json scripts ===')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('cat /root/opt/areloria/package.json')
print(stdout.read().decode())
# Check the ecosystem config
print('\\n=== PM2 Ecosystem Config ===')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('cat /root/opt/areloria/ecosystem.config.cjs')
print(stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
"
=== Server Dist Structure ===

=== Package.json scripts ===
{
  "name": "areloria-wasd",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "description": "Areloria WASD Monorepo - High-performance 3D RPG & Metaverse Platform",
  "packageManager": "pnpm@9.12.2",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "pnpm -r --parallel run dev",
    "test": "pnpm -r run test",
    "lint": "pnpm -r run lint",
    "build": "pnpm -r run build",
    "quality-check": "pnpm run lint && pnpm run test",
    "deploy": "bash scripts/deploy-vps.sh"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=20.0.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/node": "^22.19.18",
    "@types/react": "^18.3.28",
    "@types/react-dom": "^18.3.7",
    "eslint": "^10.3.0",
    "eslint-config-next": "^16.2.6",
    "typescript": "^6.0.3"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@prisma/client": "^7.8.0",
    "vitest": "^4.1.5"
  },
  "pnpm": {
    "overrides": {
      "@types/react": "^19.2.14",
      "@types/react-dom": "^19.2.3",
      "@types/node": "^22.19.18",
      "zod": "^4.4.3"
    }
  }
}


=== PM2 Ecosystem Config ===
module.exports = {
  apps: [{
    name: 'areloria',
    script: './server/dist/index.js',
    cwd: '/opt/areloria',
    instances: 1,
    autorestart: true,
    watch: false,
    max_memory_restart: '2G',
    node_args: '--max-old-space-size=2048',
    env: {
      NODE_ENV: 'production',
      PORT: 3000,
      CLIENT_ROOT_DIR: '/opt/areloria/client',
    },
    env_file: '/opt/areloria/.env',
    error_file: '/var/log/areloria/error.log',
    out_file: '/var/log/areloria/out.log',
    log_date_format: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss',
  }]
};
